bettermobparticles.config.title: Better Mob Particles
bettermobparticles.config.enabled.toolti: Turn all wound particles on or off - arrows, melee, everything.
20 ticks is one second. Droplets fall, land and fade out.
bettermobparticles.config.force.tooltip: How hard droplets are thrown out of the wound. Low values let blood well out and drop; high values fire it across the room.
bettermobparticles.config.meleeEnabled.t: Swords, axes and other tools draw blood too, not just arrows.
bettermobparticles.config.barehandChance: A bare fist or a random item draws blood only sometimes, and less of it.
